name: 60201 · Evanston, IL
findings: ZIP 60201 (Evanston) has 365 nonprofit organizations. 160 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 134 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60201 (Evanston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
